summary: Share-first export delivery: when canShareVideoFile is true, onstop skips downloadBlob, sets delivery:"share", and fire-and-forgets shareVideoFile (activation loss quiet; Share retry remains). Desktop canShare=false keeps download + delivery:"download". Success chrome/aria-live uses Ready to share {label} vs Downloaded {label} via exportSuccessLabel. Pure resolveExportDelivery unit-tested (no source greps).
goal: Simplify climb replay export delivery — use native share immediately instead of download-then-share

learnings.insight: Product intentionally overrides ADR-NS-1 for share-capable devices: onstop may call shareVideoFile once knowing NotAllowedError is common after async encode; download is gated behind !canShare; Share button remains the reliable gesture path.
learnings.action: Verify AC-SI-1…3 via resolveExportDelivery(true|false) outputs and that useReplayExport only calls downloadBlob when choice.download; do not fail review solely because share() is invoked from onstop when canShare.

learnings.insight: Share-immediate implementer: 14 production-invoking unit tests green (exportDelivery 5 + shareVideoFile 9); pnpm typecheck clean. Zero new dependencies or HTTP endpoints.
learnings.action: Map AC-SI-1/2/3 to resolveExportDelivery; AC-SI success copy to exportSuccessLabel; residual: onstop auto-share NotAllowed + Share retry in browser/QA.

appliedLearnings: Gate downloadBlob behind !canShareVideoFile; attempt share on share-capable success; Ready to share copy (product-spec)
Invoke production units in tests — no source greps (standing rule)
Auto-share after async encode often lacks activation — expected; Share retry is product intent
